theorems.name: Submission.dorag_dbs_approxTangent_lower_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < n → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → ∀ c : ℝ, c < 1 → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal c * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n) ≤ μHE[n] (M ∩ closedBall x t)
